added_claim_errors: "퇴직금 미지급은 3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금 (퇴직급여법 제44조)": outdated. From 2026.9.18 it is 제43조, 5년/5천만 원 (minor, per the key)
"2026년 10월 현재 시행 중인 법을 기준으로 정리했습니다": says current law was checked, but the penalty it gives is the old one
"퇴직소득세가 원천징수되어 실수령액은 조금 줄어듭니다": when the money goes to an IRP (which A itself says is the default), no tax is withheld at payment (소득세법 제146조②)
HR message states "세전 약 1,020만 원": this contradicts A's own 1,024만~1,202만 calculation and understates the claim at the bottom edge
"고용노동부 실무는 통상임금을 적용하는 쪽입니다": no source is given for MOEL practice, so this is unverifiable
"미지급 시 3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금": outdated. From 2026.9.18 it is 5년/5천만 원 under 제43조 (minor, per the key)
"10월 4일이 법정 기한" is stated as definite, but the exact deadline depends on how the retirement date and holidays are counted (10/3~10/6). The date falls in that range, so this is minor
"고용노동부(1350)나 관할 지청에 ... 진정을 넣을 수": 1350 is a counseling line, not a place to file a petition. Minor imprecision

reasons: Both answers correct the company's claim at the start: the deadline is 14 days, and an extension needs both a special reason and the worker's agreement. Both also give the two figures, 1,024만 on average wage and 1,202만 on the ordinary-wage floor, with correct arithmetic. B's HR message is the more complete one. It names the 10/4 deadline, asks for a breakdown and a reply by a set date, and covers how to hand over the IRP account. A's message leaves out the IRP and quotes a low 1,020만, which contradicts A's own analysis and weakens the claim. A also wrongly says retirement tax is withheld even though it treats IRP transfer as the default, and claims to use current law while citing the old 제44조 3년/3천만 penalty. B repeats the outdated penalty too, but it is tighter overall and easier to act on.
